import hashlib,json,resource,signal,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
r=Path('/workspace/poisson-p4');sys.path.insert(0,str(r/'code'))
import numpy as np
import sympy as s
import classification_symmetry_chart as c
signal.alarm(55);resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(1500000000,1500000000));start=time.monotonic()
source=r/'reports/CLASSIFICATION_SYMMETRY_NORMAL_CHART_20261106.json';old=json.loads(source.read_text());P=old['prime'];assert P==c.P==32003 and old['rank_modp']==37
M=c.mod(s.Matrix(old['closed_quadratic_beta2_basis60x45']));L=c.mod(s.Matrix(old['basis_left_inverse45x60']));W=c.mod(s.Matrix(old['plane_W45x3_QQ']));basis={};records=[];selected=[];selectedrows=[]
for original in old['records']:
 k=original['group_index'];g=s.Matrix(original['integral_g']);assert g.T*c.J*g==c.J
 A=c.finite_action(g,M,L);Wg=A@W%P;Wi,chart=c.inverse(Wg[:3]);assert chart==original['first3_plane_chart_det_modp']
 rec={'group_index':k,'first3_plane_chart_det_modp':chart};records.append(rec)
 if not chart:continue
 row=(A[3]+A[37]-(Wg[3]+Wg[37])@Wi@A[:3])%P;assert not np.any(row@W%P)
 rec['pulledback_fixed_n0_plus_n34_row45_modp']=row.tolist();v=row[3:].copy();pivot=None
 for j,oldrow in sorted(basis.items()):v=(v-v[j]*oldrow)%P
 nz=np.flatnonzero(v)
 if len(nz):
  pivot=int(nz[0]);basis[pivot]=v*pow(int(v[pivot]),-1,P)%P;selected.append(k);selectedrows.append(row[3:].tolist())
 rec['new_pivot_normal_column']=pivot;rec['cumulative_rank']=len(basis)
 if len(basis)==42:break
rank=len(basis);det=None
if rank==42:
 inv,det=c.inverse(np.array(selectedrows,dtype=np.int64));assert det
 assert np.array_equal(inv@np.array(selectedrows,dtype=np.int64)%P,np.eye(42,dtype=np.int64))
out={'task_id':'G','fixed_normal_form':'n0+n34 with rational constants1','source_normal_rows0':[0,34],'source_model_q_rows0':[3,37],'original_64group_job_path':str(source.relative_to(r)),'original_64group_job_sha256':c.sha(source),'original_basis_producer_path':'code/classification_symmetry_chart.py','original_basis_producer_sha256':c.sha(Path(c.__file__)),'same_bounded_integral_groups_only':True,'positive_rank42_certificate':rank==42,'rank_modp':rank,'prime':P,'groups_evaluated':len(records),'group_bound':64,'records':records,'selected_groups':selected,'selected42x42_rows_modp':selectedrows,'selected_determinant_modp':det,'literal_reproduction_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'reproduction_source_sha256':c.sha(Path(__file__)),'all_row_annihilation_and_representation_checks_passed':True,'one_fixed_seed_not_union_of_two_orbits':True,'unit_or_exhaustion_proved':False,'seconds':time.monotonic()-start}
p=r/'reports/CLASSIFICATION_SYMMETRY_FIXED_SUM_20261106.json'
with p.open('x')as f:json.dump(out,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
